DEMONHUNTERTEST-MARK_OF_THE_ILLIDARI.fla: "Bears the mark of Illidan. Turn in to the Scryers or the Aldor bank in Shattrath."
DEMONHUNTERTEST-MARK_OF_THE_ILLIDARI.des: Every time you play 3 [gold]Outcast[/gold] cards, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
DEMONHUNTERTEST-WARGLAIVE_OF_AZZINOTH.fl: I saw a dark dream swirling in the faint light of hellfire, a blade echoing with green light from the unseen depths.
DEMONHUNTERTEST-WARGLAIVE_OF_AZZINOTH.de: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] to all enemies and gain [green]{RegenPower}[/green] [gold]Regen[/gold].
DEMONHUNTERTEST-WARGLAIVES_OF_AZZINOTH.f: I saw a dark dream swirling in the faint light of hellfire, a blade echoing with green light from the unseen depths.
DEMONHUNTERTEST-WARGLAIVES_OF_AZZINOTH.d: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] to all enemies, and gain [green]{RegenPower}[/green] [gold]Regen[/gold] and [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DEMONHUNTERTEST-LEADER_OF_THE_ILLIDARI.f: "I will just defeat Illidan and be a good son."
DEMONHUNTERTEST-LEADER_OF_THE_ILLIDARI.d: Cards with "Illidari" in their name deal [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] more damage.
DEMONHUNTERTEST-SPIRETAKER.title: Spiretaker
DEMONHUNTERTEST-SPIRETAKER.flavor:
"If a demon harem is involved, any price is cheap."
And so you ventured into hell.
DEMONHUNTERTEST-SPIRETAKER.description: Changes the combat BGM. Upon picking up [gold]Doro[/gold], obtain a special [gold]Relic[/gold].
DEMONHUNTERTEST-DORO.title: Doro
DEMONHUNTERTEST-DORO.description: Changes the shop BGM. Upon picking up [gold]Spiretaker[/gold], obtain a special [gold]Relic[/gold].
DEMONHUNTERTEST-CARROT_HAMBURG.title: Carrot Hamburg
DEMONHUNTERTEST-CARROT_HAMBURG.flavor: "I'll be the Umamusume who enjoys the Spire the most!"
DEMONHUNTERTEST-CARROT_HAMBURG.descripti: Upon obtaining an [gold]edible relic[/gold], fully heal your HP.
DEMONHUNTERTEST-SOUR_GRAPES.title: Sour Grapes
DEMONHUNTERTEST-SOUR_GRAPES.description: Upon pickup, obtain [red]Maiev[/red] and a special [gold]Relic[/gold].
DEMONHUNTERTEST-CRYSTAL_PRISON.title: Crystal Prison
DEMONHUNTERTEST-CRYSTAL_PRISON.flavor: Illidan was imprisoned here for ten thousand years.
DEMONHUNTERTEST-CRYSTAL_PRISON.descripti: At the start of combat, [gold]Stun[/gold] all enemies for 2 turns.
